name: The Liberty SiriusXM Group
summary: The Liberty SiriusXM Group operates within the entertainment sector across the United States and Canada, providing audio content including music, sports, comedy, talk shows, news, and podcasts via satellite radio and streaming, alongside connected vehicle services. Headquartered in Englewood, Colorado, the group is a subsidiary of Liberty Media Corporation. This row represents its Brazilian Depositary Receipt (BDR), traded on B3.
